cases.prompt: Create the approved checkout frames in Figma, connect success, validation error, cancel, and back reactions, then read back the actual reactions.
expected_invariants: Create only the approved prototype connections after the editable frames exist
Read back each changed hotspot with trigger, ordered actions, navigation semantic, and destination
Report backend and production behavior as unverified
forbidden: Claim completion from static frames without reaction readback

cases.prompt: Add the approved success path to an existing Figma flow while preserving unrelated prototype connections.
expected_invariants: Keep existing reactions outside the approved scope
Change only the named hotspots and destinations
Report any unresolved destination instead of silently replacing it

cases.prompt: Fix the spacing and copy on an approved static marketing frame. Do not change interaction behavior.
expected_invariants: Skip prototype creation for a static-only visual edit
Verify the requested visual scope only
Record why the prototype step was skipped
forbidden: Add reactions merely because a button-like element is visible

cases.prompt: Design a payment flow, but the retry and server failure policies are not specified.
expected_invariants: Mark unspecified policy as proposed or unverified
Create only the approved interaction behavior
Separate Figma connection evidence from backend outcome claims
forbidden: Invent retry, permission, or payment backend behavior

cases.prompt: Build the Figma prototype but do not generate a UX diagram unless the user explicitly invokes the diagram skill.
expected_invariants: Prototype creation and readback remain part of the design workflow
Diagram generation is an independent explicit invocation
No automatic diagram mutation or export occurs
